#7228. Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Toronto Remote at Camunda

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.

You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

#7224. Senior Forward Deployed Engineer at Clutch

Clutch builds AI agents that work on behalf of credit unions. Emma, our collections agent, is live at five credit unions and handled 60,000+ member conversations in her first twelve weeks at one of them. Behind her is a growing portfolio: origination, fraud step-up, member (re)engagement and activation agents, all built on the same Agents Platform (TypeScript, NestJS, our own agent SDK, MCP, Temporal, promptfoo).

As a FDE you are one of the two engineers on an agent. You take it from "sold" to "live and performing" at a specific credit union: you sit in the discovery sessions, you build the integrations to their core banking and loan systems, you author and tune the agent's behavior, you run the live tests with their staff, and you stay with it through go-live and the first weeks of production. When something needs a person in the room, you are the one who flies.

This is a senior engineering role, not a solutions or support role. You write production code in our monorepo every week: integrations, modules, and the agents themselves (prompts, tools, evals), together with the other engineers on the pod. The difference from a traditional engineer is that you are on site more often, you make judgment calls in front of the customer, and you own the outcome. What you learn in the field flows straight back into the product: defaults, playbooks, and the platform capabilities the next agent will need.

You build; our AI Operations Managers deliver. The pod (pod lead plus engineers) designs and builds each agent in a high-touch way with the first customers. Once the agent is defined and live, AI Ops coordinates the implementations, configuration and ongoing success at the next credit unions. You hand them something that works and a playbook to run it.

This role requires roughly 20% of travel on average, with one- to two-week stretches around kickoffs and go-lives. Based in the US, able to travel on short notice

You'll join the Agents team, a small, senior group operating as a startup inside Clutch: seven engineers, a dedicated AI product group, and AI sales specialists, working directly with some of the largest credit unions in the country. Every agent is staffed by a pair of engineers, one leaning toward the conversation and LLM side, one toward software and integrations, with a pod lead who owns the product day to day. There is no layer between you and the customer, and no layer between you and the platform team.

The operating style is direct, written, and evidence-driven: BLUF updates, evals over opinions, business outcomes over ticket counts. The team is spread across Brazil, Argentina and the US and works async by default. Being on site is a tool we use at specific moments (kickoff, live testing, go-live), not a permanent posting.

Ship your first production change to a live agent through the team's review process, and be able to explain how a member's call flows through the Agents Platform end to end

Learn one agent deeply: system prompt, tool contracts, orchestration triggers, compliance gates, and the implementation process from kickoff to go-live

Join at least one credit union implementation as the second engineer, including a live testing session with their staff

Map where the current implementation process loses time and where a default or a tool would have removed a round trip

Own the technical side of one credit union implementation end to end: core and LOS integration, agent configuration, testing, go-live, and the first weeks of production

Run the eval and tuning loop for your agent (golden transcripts, rubric judges, regression suite) and be trusted to change its behavior without a second engineer checking your work

Have completed at least two on-site visits and turned what you heard there into product decisions with your pod lead and PM

Contribute at least one reusable capability back to the Agents Platform that the next implementation will not have to rebuild

Have taken one net-new agent from sold to live at its first credit union, with data you can show the partner

Be the engineer credit union staff ask for by name when something in their deployment needs to change

Have written the implementation playbook for your agent well enough that the AI Ops team runs the second and third credit union without you

Be shaping what the next agents look like, because you have seen where the current ones break in the field

7+ years of software engineering in a fast-paced environment, preferably in SaaS and/or Fintech, with senior TypeScript and Node.js backend experience in a large codebase (NestJS, CQRS, schema-validated boundaries, dependency injection). We do not count years of AI experience; the field is too young for that to mean anything. We look at what you have shipped and how you reason about it

Integration and API engineering: secure service-to-service endpoints, third-party APIs, webhooks, and the patience to work with legacy banking systems that were not designed to be integrated

Security and auth judgment: OAuth and machine-to-machine auth, tenant-scoped access, secrets handling, no PII in logs. Our agents touch sensitive member data and operate under consumer-contact regulation

Customer presence: you can sit across from a VP of Collections, hear a request, and say "here is what I recommend and why", including when the answer is no. You are comfortable making calls in the room and owning them afterwards

Code-quality judgment under deadline pressure: you take on debt deliberately, name it, and pay it down, rather than gold-plating or leaving silent debt behind

Genuine appetite for LLM agents: eval discipline for non-deterministic systems, reading a system prompt like code, understanding that some decisions must never reach the model. Curiosity plus shipped work is enough; research depth is not required

Nice to have, explicitly not required: voice and telephony (LiveKit, Twilio), Temporal or event-driven orchestration, Python, core banking or LOS integration experience, credit union or banking domain knowledge

#7222. Staff GTM Systems Engineer at LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

The Staff GTM Systems Engineer at LiveKit is the technical owner and architect of the systems that power our go-to-market engine. You'll decide how our GTM stack is designed, what we build versus buy, and where we invest next — and you'll be hands-on building it: Salesforce architecture, integrations, enrichment pipelines, and the agentic workflows that help Sales and Marketing move faster and smarter.

Salesforce is our system of record for revenue, pipeline, and customer data. HubSpot is our marketing layer for campaigns and lead generation, and what it captures needs to flow cleanly and reliably into Salesforce. Around them sits a growing stack of enrichment, sales intelligence, billing, and data platform tools. You'll own the architecture that ties it all together: disciplined change management, observable pipelines, data models built for AI consumption, and agentic workflows that act on GTM signals at scale — designed to serve the business for years, not quarters.

This role sits at the intersection of GTM, Data, Finance, and Engineering. You'll work directly with senior leaders to shape the GTM systems roadmap, turn business strategy into technical plans, and guide decisions that span multiple teams. You'll also help grow the engineers around you, setting the technical standards and practices the team builds on.

You understand the difference between owning a system and gatekeeping one. Sales lives in Salesforce. Marketing lives in HubSpot. Your job is to make sure both are governed well enough that others can work in them effectively, and powerful enough that the GTM team can do things they couldn't do before.

You'll thrive as a Staff GTM Systems Engineer if you:

Are known as the go-to person for tough technical problems, and have good judgment about which ones matter most.

Think in systems and long time horizons, and can make confident architectural decisions with incomplete information.

Can clearly explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to engineers and executives alike.

Believe systems should be managed with engineering discipline.

Ship fast and reliably — your work holds up in production.

Are a fast learner, frequently picking up new languages and tools.

Find real satisfaction in mentoring other engineers and helping them grow.

Own the architecture of the GTM systems stack: define how Salesforce, HubSpot, enrichment, sales intelligence, billing, and the data platform fit together, and write the technical strategy that guides how it evolves.

Lead build-vs-buy and procurement decisions: evaluate vendors, run proofs of concept, assess security and integration fit, and partner with Director of GTM Systems and Analytics, Finance, Legal, and IT on selection and renewals.

Shape the GTM systems roadmap with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Finance, and Engineering: align on requirements, sequence investments, make clear tradeoffs, and lead cross-functional initiatives to completion.

Own Salesforce as the engineering system of record for revenue: data model, flows and automation, validation rules, field governance, and access control.

Own HubSpot for campaigns and lead generation, along with the HubSpot-Salesforce sync — so leads, contacts, and engagement signals reach the revenue pipeline without drift or silent failures.

Build and maintain integrations across the GTM stack, and partner with GTM Analytics Engineering on reliable data flows to the central data platform.

Design and deploy agentic workflows that consume GTM data, surface actionable signals, and automate manual operations — and set the patterns and guardrails others build on.

Establish observability and change management for critical GTM systems: alerts, dashboards, and runbooks; reviewed code changes, documented config, and rollback paths.

Mentor engineers across experience levels and set the technical standards for the team.

Partner with the Billing Systems Engineer to automate the CPQ-to-Billing handoff.

Extensive engineering experience in GTM or business systems, including owning a GTM stack's architecture end to end — build-vs-buy calls, vendor evaluations, and systems designed for a multi-year horizon.

Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise — you understand the data model, have built complex flows and automation, and you think about it as an engineering system, not an admin tool. This is the primary bar.

HubSpot experience in a marketing context, including the HubSpot-Salesforce sync and what breaks and why.

Technical depth beyond the UI — you've built integrations with APIs, webhooks, and event streams, and you know when a native tool (a Flow, a Clay table, a HubSpot workflow) is the right answer versus when it's time to write code.

Agentic workflow experience — you've designed and deployed AI agents that act on GTM data in production.

Strong change management practices — you've shipped changes to live systems while protecting active deals and campaigns.

Experience influencing senior stakeholders — translating business strategy into system requirements and roadmaps.

A history of mentoring engineers, from early-career to senior.

Salesforce CPQ: approvals, order forms, discounting rules, and the closed-won-to-billing path.

SQL and data modeling fluency; familiarity with a warehouse-centric stack (BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt, reverse ETL).

Experience with billing platforms (Stripe, Zuora, Maxio) and the handoffs between GTM systems and billing.

Experience managing a GTM tooling budget or vendor portfolio.

Experience as a technical lead on a GTM or business systems team.

An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

#7219. Senior Manager, Business Operations at Clutch

Clutch is at a pivotal moment. We're growing significantly year over year, and we need more connective tissue to keep pace. We're hiring a Senior Manager, Business Operations to connect the commercial side of the house, so the teams that win, onboard, and retain our customers work from the same facts and toward the same goals. This role sits in Finance.

This is a people manager role. You'll lead our Revenue Operations (RevOps) team and act as an operating partner to senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, People, and Finance. Together with the RevOps team, you own the shared language of the business (definitions, data, and processes) so commercial teams make decisions from one view of it.

When something important doesn't have an owner yet, it lands with you: a partnership strategy, a new commercial model, or pricing and margin guidance for leadership. This is a fast-moving startup. We're building toward a much larger company but we aren't one yet, and most of this role has no playbook. You'll define the process, build the tool, and hand it to the team. If you want established structure, this likely isn't the role.

You'll report to the Director of Business Operations and work directly with senior leaders across the company as a neutral partner to every function rather than an advocate for one. Your work will be visible, and it will significantly influence how we make commercial decisions.

You'll lead a small, high-ownership RevOps team that runs the systems and data our commercial teams depend on, and creates leverage for them to do their jobs even better. The team doesn't just own systems. They build automation, tooling, and processes, and they're close partners to Sales and Marketing. You'll coach them, set priorities, and open up more strategic scope, while giving them real autonomy.

Learn the business end to end: the revenue funnel, the customer lifecycle, how each commercial team works day to day, and where decisions get stuck

Build trust with your RevOps team: learn the work they own, and set priorities and team rhythms together

Deliver the first version of client-level margin and cost-to-serve, the analysis that grounds our pricing strategy

Develop a first point of view on pricing and packaging for revenue leadership, built on that analysis

Put AI to work in your own workflow from week one, and identify the first set of manual, repetitive processes across the commercial teams worth automating

Stand up a first version of a deal desk, including an approval workflow, pricing and discount guardrails, and standard commercial terms

Partner with Sales and Marketing leaders as they prepare for the monthly business review: pressure-test their plans and point out risks, then solve them with the RevOps team by creating new processes, tooling, or automation

Build on the strength of the RevOps team: prioritize its roadmap against business outcomes and take on more strategic work together

Launch your first AI-enabled workflows or automations that remove manual reporting or reconciliation for the commercial teams, with time saved tracked

Have a team whose output and standards hold, with the processes, tooling, and automation you've built running without you in the room

Have AI-enabled, self-serve tooling that commercial teams use day to day, with measurable time savings

Be the person leadership trusts to pick up the next important thing that doesn't have an owner yet

5-8 years of total experience that combines consulting or banking with time as an operator inside a company

Experience managing people: you've coached ICs, given direct feedback, made tough talent calls, and built team rhythms

Startup experience. You've worked in a fast-moving, ever-changing environment where structure wasn't already there, and you built it. This is not a role for someone whose experience is only at large, established enterprises.

Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, including forecasting. You're very comfortable building models in spreadsheets from scratch, and they hold up to scrutiny. You use AI to move faster and sharpen your work, and you have the foundational modeling knowledge to know when its output is wrong.

Data-first and self-sufficient. You open the dataset before you build the slide, you're always looking for more data to test an idea, and you're comfortable getting into raw data yourself. You use AI to analyze it faster and know enough to check its work.

Commercial acumen: you can read commercial terms, spot the problematic ones, and reason about pricing, discounting, margin, and deal structure

A clear communicator who can walk an executive through a messy problem and leave them with a decision, and who is just as effective working alongside an AE, a CSM, or an engineer

Comfort with ambiguity. When something isn't set up yet, your instinct is to build it, not to wait for it. You create structure, manage competing priorities, and pivot when things change.

Relentless follow-through: you close loops, and people stop checking on what you've said you'll do

A partner's temperament: you challenge constructively without taking sides, you surface problems early, and you resolve cross-team conflict without escalating it

Industry experience in fintech, financial services, lending, banking, or credit unions

#7189. PDRN—AKA Salmon Sperm—Is the Buzziest Skincare Ingredient of the Year. Should You Use It, Though?

There’s some really interesting skin science behind it.

We may earn commission from links on this page, but we only recommend products we love. Promise.

Would you slather salmon sperm on your face? TBH, you might already be. PDRN has been one of the buzziest skincare ingredients of the year, and its prevalence is thanks to the Korean skincare boom. Dermatologists think that this ingredient is only going to become more popular, too. "PDRN has real staying power because there are decades of science-based research that is supported by medical use, which gives it credibility,” says Melda Isaac, MD

Before you freak, it’s not like skincare products have raw salmon sperm in them. (That would be a serious health violation.) I sought to understand the ingredient a bit more, and the science is interesting. PDRN might just be the coolest ingredient, like ever. Intrigued? Well, you’re in the right place. Keep reading to learn everything you need to know about PDRN.

PDRN, or polydeoxyribonucleotide, "are DNA fragments derived from sperm cells of certain trout or, more commonly in skincare, salmon," says Dr. Isaac. So, yeah, you technically are slathering the sperm of a lil salmon on your face. But don't worry, Dr. Isaac confirms that the extracted sperm is filtered to remove impurities, then sterilized so that it's suitable for topical use.

Why sperm, though? "Studies indicate that salmon sperm are the most suitable source for the extraction of highly purified DNA without the risk of impurities due to their low levels of proteins, peptides, and other contaminants compared to other DNA sources," says Dr. Isaac.

PDRN is fantastic for a variety of skin concerns, especially regenerating tissue and cell renewal, which helps skin become more resilient, elastic, firmer, and smoother. Basically, it can help stimulate collagen production, improve skin texture and tone, make pores look tighter, and reduce fine lines and wrinkles.

To get science-y, "it works primarily by activating adenosine A2A receptors, which are crucial in anti-inflammatory effects," shares Dr. Isaac. It's largely used to "promote cell growth and repair and enhance the skin’s natural healing process, making it an ideal component for post-treatment recovery," she adds. But it can also inhibit melanin production to help reduce hyperpigmentation, making it great for getting rid of acne scars and sun spots.

PDRN isn’t just found in topical products. Some people opt to get PDRN injections at med spas and doctor’s offices. The biggest difference between what you get during a professional treatment versus what’s in a skincare formula is the concentration. PDRN that's injected into skin during a procedure at a derm's office is much more potent than what you'd find in Hailey Bieber's favorite Medicube PDRN Collagen Gel Mask.

It's also important to keep in mind that PDRN products differ when it comes to strength and in how they were manufactured. Dr. Isaac urges you to consider if the product contains salmon DNA or trout DNA (as this can potentially change the efficacy and strength of results), plus where the salmon is coming from (was it farm-raised or freshly caught from pure streams or rivers, she notes).

When it comes to at-home formulas, Dr. Isaac is pro-PDRN in basically all forms. Most of all, she recommends choosing something that you can be consistent with. "Serums are designed for daily use and long-term maintenance, while masks provide an immediate boost since they are left on the skin longer, allowing ingredients to soak in," she explains. Adding a PDRN serum, like VT Cosmetics PDRN 100 Essence Serum, to your nighttime skincare routine is often the easiest option. Or incorporate it with a weekly overnight mask (I've been loving Abib PDRN Collagen Overnight Mask for my acne-prone skin) or a PDRN sheet mask. "In the treatment room, I think PDRN masks are a great addition to post-laser care as they offer immediate soothing properties and improve downtime or recovery period," she adds.

Dr. Isaac recommends combining at-home treatments with your in-office procedures to double up on your results. FWIW, her go-to product at-home is LúmEnvy Glass Skin Brightening Serum, which she finds helps expedite the skin's healing process after cosmetic treatments, as well as improves skin luminosity and texture. Contributing beauty editor, Mary Honkus, can attest to this. She used the Medicube PDRN Pink Collagen Capsule Cream post laser-facial, and her skin healed much faster than her dermatologist said it would—legit in less than a week.

The best thing about PDRN is that it's gentle and effective for all skin types, including sensitive, notes Dr. Isaac. "It doesn’t strip or over-correct, making it safe across the board," she says. In fact, you can even use it with actives—including retinol, growth factors, AHAs, BHAs, and vitamin C—to help reduce irritation.

One thing to keep in mind: Proceed with caution if you have a fish or shellfish allergy, Dr. Isaac warns. Talk to your doctor before you start using a product just to be sure it won't cause irritation (and of course, any new product you add into your routine puts you at risk for some irritation, even if you don't think you're allergic to it). There is usually a lot of purification done with these formulas, but an allergic response could possibly happen, so it's best to be safe.

While rubbing salmon sperm on your skin might sound a lil freaky, it's actually backed by science to help smooth and tighten. Who woulda thought? While an in-office facial using PDRN might lead to quicker and more noticeable results, at-home topical masks, serums, and creams are also pretty effective and compound results over time. "It truly is one of those rare ingredients that transcends hydration, repair, and renewal universally," says Dr. Isaac.

As for what the future holds for salmon sperm, Dr. Isaac is convinced we're just getting started. "I think there will be increased concentrations of the active ingredients, more combinations of PDRN with other rejuvenating products, and there will be more options in delivery mechanisms, including injections of PDRN into deeper tissues," she says.

Beth Gillette is the beauty editor at Cosmopolitan with seven years of experience researching, writing, and editing skincare stories that range from vitamin C serums to butt acne.

Mary Honkus is a beauty contributor for Cosmopolitan with over eight years of experience researching, writing, and editing beauty stories. She is an authority in all beauty categories and has tested plenty of PDRN products in the past year.

Beth Gillette is the beauty editor at Cosmopolitan, where she covers skincare, makeup, hair, nails, and more across digital and print. She can generally be found in bright eyeshadow furiously typing her latest feature or hemming and hawing about a new product you "have to try." Prior to Cosmopolitan, she wrote and edited beauty content as an Editor at The Everygirl for four years. Follow her on Instagram for makeup selfies and a new hair 'do every few months.

#7173. Behold: Your Official ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Season 35 Cast Elimination Tracker

Get your dancing shoes ready, because season 35 of Dancing With the Stars is finally here! The reality dancing competition returned for a new season of live shows on September 15, and the show locked in some pretty major stars for the competition, from Olympian Amber Glenn to reality star Ciara Miller.

As always, this season of DWTS is pitting pop stars, reality show alums, actors, and professional athletes against one another in a heated classic ballroom competition. Each celeb is, of course, paired with a dance pro to guide them through their journey and help them get the biggest honor of all: the Mirrorball Trophy.

The entire season 35 cast was announced on Good Morning America on September 2, along with their professional partners, and here’s everything you need to know about the cast...including who has already been eliminated. (Side note: We’ll be keeping this updated each week, so check back to see who’s still in the competition.)

It wouldn’t be a season of DWTS without a few athletes, and in season 35, you can look forward to seeing two-time Paralympian Ezra Frech.

Known for: Tokyo 2020 Paralympics and Paris 2024 Paralympics (where he won two gold medals!)

Dance experience: He competes in track and field, but as far as I know, he’s new to the world of dance.

ABC always loves to throw an Olympian in the mix, and this season, it’s Blade Angel Amber, who revealed during an episode of House of Maher that “it’s been a dream of mine” to do DWTS “since I saw Meryl [Davis] do it in 2014.”

Dance experience: If you’ve seen Amber on the ice, then you know she’s a dancer at heart.

Last season, it was Alix Earle—but this season, the internet personality competing for the Mirrorball Trophy is Connor Wood, aka Fibula (who, btw, is good friends with DWTS alum Dylan Efron).

Known for: Brooke and Connor Make a Podcast and Fibs & Friends

Dance experience: If he has any, it’s news to me!

Big news for Fresh Prince fans, because Tatyana will be joining her onscreen big brother, DWTS host Alfonso Ribeiro, in the ballroom.

Known for: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air and The Young and the Restless

Dance experience: While she’s better known for her singing skills, let’s not forget that we have her to thank for the TikTok dance trend set to Doechii’s “Anxiety.”

Maura was also rumored for months before her casting was announced. Back in March, she even told The Hollywood Reporter that DWTS would “be a huge challenge,” but one she was willing to take on. “I know I’d throw myself into it and all the looks and glitter,” she added.

Known for: Love Island UK, The Traitors, and Love Island USA: Aftersun

Dance experience: Maura told THR that she did “a bit of Irish dancing” when she was younger.

You know him for a million TV shows and movies, but did you know Harry was a professional dancer at the beginning of his career? Something tells us he’s still got it...

Known for: Glee, Shadowhunters, Grey’s Anatomy, and Crazy Rich Asians, among others

Dance experience: He served as a backup dancer for Beyoncé, Jennifer Lopez, Mariah Carey, and Madonna before transitioning to acting.

Jenna is stepping back into her dancing shoes! She started her career as a professional backup dancer before becoming an actor. But dancing has always been in her DNA, so we’re thrilled she’s back at it.

Known for: Step Up, Witches of East End, and The Rookie, among others

Dance experience: Where to begin! Jenna is an extremely experienced dancer and rose to fame thanks to Step Up. She was also a backup dancer for Janet Jackson.

She’s been in several iconic aughts movies, including Save the Last Dance. In fact, if she doesn’t recreate her dance from that movie, I will personally write a letter of complaint.

Dance experience: Once again: Save the Last Dance.

Along with an Olympian, most seasons of DWTS include a member of Bachelor Nation...and this season, it’s Tyler, who’s ready to compete six years after his ex, Hannah Brown, took first place in season 28.

Known for: The Bachelorette, Special Forces, and Going Home with Tyler Cameron

Dance experience: He competed on The Real Dirty Dancing back in 2022 (and finished as a runner-up!).

Back in December 2025, Jackson replied to a fan who asked whether he would “go on Dancing With the Stars next season” with a video compilation of dance clips, which he captioned, “Long story short... yes, yes I would.” Dreams do come true!

Known for: The Savannah Bananas baseball team and TikTok

Dance experience: Though he’s done plenty of choreography since joining the Savannah Bananas in 2022, Jackson surprisingly has no formal dance background.

As Jimmy Kimmel joked when his onscreen sidekick was announced: “Guillermo will become the first-ever parking lot security guard to dance with the stars.”

Known for: Jimmy Kimmel Live! (though he first rose to fame while working as a parking lot security guard at the Hollywood Boulevard Masonic Temple studio)

Dance experience: None that I know of, but I’m excited to see him bust out some moves!

Ciara was rumored to be joining the cast for season 34, but this year, it’s finally happening! As she told Us Weekly when the rumors first began, “I want [a pro] who is hard on me. Like, ‘You got to get this down.’”

Known for: Summer House, The Traitors, and Love Island USA: Aftersun

Dance experience: Ciara actually grew up dancing, and revealed to Us Weekly that she took ballet for 10 years.

Fans have been side-eyeing the middle Hanson brother ever since he showed up in the audience during season 34’s “Wicked Night” episode—and it seems that he is, indeed, hitting the stage this season.

Dance experience: Seeing as he spends most of his time behind the keyboard while performing, this is a little unclear.

Any Food Network fans here? Then you’re well aware of Giada, who’s been a household name for decades.

Known for: Giada at Home (among many other Food Network shows)

Dance experience: Unclear, but I’m excited to see what moves she might have!

Brooks Nader’s sister is following in her footsteps and we can’t wait!

Dance experience: TBD, but we’ll find out!

After cheering on his wife Whitney Leavitt during season 34, The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives fan fave is now stepping into the ballroom himself (though let’s not forget that he already took the stage last year during Whitney’s Dedication Night dance).

Known for: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives

Dance experience: Aside from doing TikTok dances, Conner appeared in the Off-Broadway dance show 11 to Midnight.

#7168. Here’s What the Luckiest Day of November Has In Store for Your Zodiac

November may almost be over, but the luckiest astrology of the month arrives this week! On Saturday, November 28, Venus and Jupiter, the two luckiest planets in the sky, share a sweet, cosmic kiss. Thanks to this year’s Venus Retrograde, this is the third and final time these two planets are meeting this year (Venus and Jupiter also met up on August 17 and November 4). Certain themes and storylines from those time periods will resurface, and November 28 brings the grand finale!

Venus is a planet of relationships, pleasure, creativity, and personal values, while Jupiter focuses on expansion, luck, justice, abundance, and wisdom. When these two planets come together, it can often bring periods of progress, something worth celebrating, or a much-needed reprieve. With Venus in Libra and Jupiter in Leo, this lucky pairing is more outwardly expressive and confident. The energy is social, lively, and flirty. So, yes, post your sexy selfie or get back on the dating apps. Apply to your dream job or share your feelings with someone special. Bet on yourself and take a step toward one of your dreams. There is more support available to us in the sky today, making November 28 the prime time to center who and what you desire and lead with your most confident and courageous self.

In the backdrop of the day, the moon moves through Leo, also reminding you that it’s not a crime to center yourself from time to time! Let yourself be the main character and don’t feel guilty about it. However, Venus in Libra will also form an opposition with Chiron in Aries, stirring up old relationship wounds and dynamics that deserve some attention. It will be easier to feel triggered today, but showing up vulnerably and confronting what’s been left unsaid, especially in some of your close connections, can pave the way for a healthier foundation or help set you free from old dynamics that you don’t deserve.

And even though today’s energy is considered lucky, helpful or positive, if you’re not feeling it, there’s nothing wrong with you. There is no need to gloss over the fact that we are living through unprecedented times and a single astrological aspect isn’t going to change that. There are a lot of very real, heavy events unfolding in the world that might make this energy seem trivial—or even impossible. But this energy can inspire you to get involved, as it’s wonderful for building community and finding shared purpose through connection with others.

It also helps you reflect on your personal values—Venus in Libra strives for balance, creativity, peace, and justice, and Jupiter in Leo reminds you of your own unique, inner light, talent, and spark that only you can bring to the table—or the party. This is an aligned time to think about how you can share some of your gifts to make a wider impact while also embodying your personal values and beliefs instead of just thinking about them. You’re coming up with creative solutions to give back and participate in building a world that is more just, by taking an active role and sharing your unique gifts and talents with others.

In your personal life, you might feel creatively satisfied or experience a moment with someone special that brings out a deep feeling of gratitude. Venus and Jupiter connections can help you live in the present moment, reminding you of the big and small things you are grateful for in your life. Here’s how this energy will manifest and how to make the most of it, based on your zodiac sign.

The chemistry is off the charts today! Passion, romance, creativity, and play are all-consuming today and your energy is magnetic and intoxicating to others. This is an amazing day to invest in your romantic life, experiment with your sexuality, or spice up an existing relationship. You’re also sharing what you love with people you love—maybe a bestie joins you for an evening of crafting or you introduce someone you’re dating to a bestie. Your joy is of the utmost importance today and it’s contagious. When you lean into it, miracles unfold around you.

It’s time to let go of the past! You’re in the mood to heal and feel, and spending time with people who are your greatest support system can help remind you of exactly who you are. If there are certain situations, habits, or people in your life that have overstayed their welcome, this energy can help you make changes with more ease, bringing more balance into your daily life. You’re also standing out in your daily life and interactions—whether it’s at work or at the coffee shop, people are paying attention so take up some space.

The news you’ve been waiting for and hoping for shows up! You could sign an exciting contract, hear back from a crush, or get started on your own memoir. You’re in a very self-expressive mood—from what you have to say and share to the way you dress to what you share on the internet. When you take up space and lead with your most confident self, new opportunities and potential collaborators also show up. The energy is also social and lively, putting you in a flirty and outgoing mood, so send the flirty text and shoot your shot.

You’re feeling more secure and grateful by the minute. You could learn news at work that brings a sense of financial security and feels personally validating like finally being recognized for your unique talents and gifts. You might also have an opportunity to stand up for your beliefs and embody your personal values, which may feel stabilizing and healing in the process. Spending time with your chosen family and loved ones who love and accept all of you can be just the confidence boost you need or help you sink into the gratitude of the support system around you.

Speak what’s on your mind and let any doubt fall to the wayside. You’re entering your “yes” era and you could learn lucky or hopeful news today. When you share your ideas and feelings with others and remain true to yourself in the process, that’s when you will shine the brightest and make progress. This energy helps you take the first step toward one of your ideas so you can reach some of your personal goals with less resistance and more support around you.

The most efficient thing you can do is slow down and spend some time alone. Pouring your energy into practices that are grounding and strengthen your intuition is the investment to make today. Spending time in meditation, reflecting in the bath, or on a walk can help you sort through any energetic gunk or others’ opinions so you can reconnect with your own inner knowing. Prioritizing your needs and solitude will give you enough space to have the ah-hah moment you’re craving.

Put yourself out there and take a friend with you! You might make a new friend today or receive a last-minute invitation that fills you with a sense of belonging. Today can also have a right-place-at-the-right-time kind of energy—so all you have to do is make sure you’re putting yourself in new environments. Collaborations are beneficial, too, and sharing from your heart and finding others who have similar ideals and values as you can help you make progress on some of your visions for your future, both personally and for the collective.

Hit snooze and sit this one out! If you’ve felt under extra pressure to reach a certain goal or milestone in your life, today your job is to turn inward and release the need to seek anyone else’s approval. The Universe is conspiring to remind you that you’re on your very own timeline and you’re doing great, sweetie. Cultivate practices that connect you with your own body and inner voice—whether it’s booking a massage appointment or finding a meditation circle. You might also hear a compliment from someone unexpected that feels soothing, healing, and affirming.

You’re feeling adventurous and want to make memories with friends that none of you will ever forget! Conversations go smoothly and decisions you make leave you feeling grateful, excited, and can bring a deep sense of belonging. You might have a fun event to attend with some BFFs or maybe you’re pitching yourself to someone influential who can help make your dreams a reality. The key to accessing the magic available to you today is to use your voice. Speak your truth, share your feelings honestly, and don’t be afraid to bet on yourself.

The investment is paying off! You could land a new job or contract or finally get that raise you asked for. You’re finally starting to see the results from all of your hard work and effort—and so are others, too. Before you set off onto the next goal, your lesson here is to celebrate yourself and how far you’ve come. Soak up the compliments and let others spoil you. You might also show up more vulnerably in a relationship, strengthening your bond in the process.

It’s time to discuss the future. You know what you want and who you want to share it, so let them in on what your heart desires! This energy is wonderful for planning a trip with a lover or bestie, deciding to go back to school, sharing your five-year plan with a lover, or sharing your feelings with someone important in your life. When you speak from the heart, others know how to show up better to meet your needs. You might also learn about a new contract or make an exciting commitment today.

You’re investing in your future self, one small step at a time. The key to meeting your future self and achieving your manifestations is changing one habit at a time. It’s also possible a habit you once tried hard to integrate into your daily life is now on autopilot. You’re meeting change with less resistance and even making more time for pleasure and play in your daily life. This energy helps remind you that prioritizing your joy is also healing work. You might also receive some supportive financial news or find a way to streamline something in your daily life that once felt exhausting or draining.
